annotations.limitations: Control-flow interpretation; not a counted-loop algorithm identification.
annotations.meaning: 01C pushes 01D; BLT at 01E consumes that entry.
annotations.name: call-fed loop entry

annotations.limitations: No physical completion or restart protocol identified.
annotations.meaning: Helper calls and computed dispatch lead to the unconditional self-branch at 084.
annotations.name: terminal tail

annotations.limitations: Register identities depend on A/B roles; not proven serial output.
annotations.meaning: Four RAM right-shift destinations followed by return; Q is not shifted.
annotations.name: register right-shift helper

annotations.limitations: Local current-flag fixtures take at most eight shifts. The fitted previous-flag policy can take nine; not a proven multiplier.
annotations.meaning: Right-shift Q and store shifted value; loop exit can test zero.
annotations.name: conditional Q drain

annotations.limitations: External D selection and destination registers remain hypotheses; caller effects depend on the mapping.
annotations.meaning: Candidate D,Q operations write R0 repeatedly or R10-R13 with swapped roles.
annotations.name: preparation with disputed register roles

annotations.limitations: Output grouping is virtual; no physical write enable or DAC destination identified. Identities were search constraints.
annotations.meaning: Four-entry tables combine paired 16-bit operands using sums/differences and permutation.
annotations.name: paired add/subtract and permute

annotations.limitations: Tested with local nonzero operands; reset-call source pairs in earlier studies were zero. Identities were search constraints.
annotations.meaning: Four entries produce (X,Y),(-Y,X),(-X,-Y),(Y,-X) modulo 65536.
annotations.name: paired quarter-turn transform

annotations.limitations: Do not extend the independent transform formula to this table; source aliasing changes later reads.
annotations.meaning: Writes overlap source Y; independent quarter-turn interpretation fails.
annotations.name: source-overlapping transform

annotations.limitations: Reachability requires site-scoped ROM-table hypotheses; unrestricted nesting overflows.
annotations.meaning: Wrapper reaches computed call 2C4 and returns at 2C5.
annotations.name: nested computed-call wrapper

annotations.limitations: Disconnected from reset in the current graph; condition select 2 meaning unknown.
annotations.meaning: Selects the 2D9 or 2DC adjustment tail.
annotations.name: conditional adjustment selector

annotations.limitations: Local probes only. No first-Y consumer identified; wrapper paths differ by one cycle.
annotations.meaning: The two tails differ by one in first Y and converge to equal modeled state at 07B.
annotations.name: transient one-unit adjustment

annotations.limitations: Site, bank, range and index source remain hypotheses; see current table provenance in the listing.
annotations.meaning: Scenario supplies targets from lookup-ROM bytes plus explicit banks.
annotations.name: ROM-backed dispatch candidate

annotations.limitations: Requires the tested previous-flag reset path, zero Q at 18D and zero carry at both writes; physical input source unknown.
annotations.meaning: In the tested reset path, 18D loads external X into R3 and 19C stores its complement in R4 for the later poll.
annotations.name: successor-byte wait preparation

annotations.limitations: Flag timing is hypothetical; physical input channel and protocol unknown. Current-flag control tests a different value.
annotations.meaning: Under previous-zero loop control, wait until D+R4 is zero modulo 256, then return. The tested caller makes this a successor-byte wait.
annotations.name: external-byte equality poll

annotations.limitations: Previous-zero condition, zero shift fill and original register roles; transient ALU outputs may matter externally. Not an established multiply/divide or physical delay.
annotations.meaning: Load and drain shifted S+C and S from R4; preserves R1-R15 and clears Q/R0 in tested local fixtures.
annotations.name: paired Q drains

annotations.limitations: Local caller-249 fixtures only. R7=FF gives exact repeated states for most constant-D/Q combinations; actual caller preconditions and external channel unknown.
annotations.meaning: Shift Q and emit biased R0 values; termination depends on external D and R7 under the previous-flag policy.
annotations.name: input-dependent biased Q shift

annotations.limitations: Original-role previous-flag and zero-fill assumptions. Seeded reset dispatch reaches the wrapper with R7=FF and Q=D; physical dispatch and external-input behavior remain unresolved.
annotations.meaning: Calls two right-shift loops and one left-shift loop without initializing R7; constant-D fixtures often repeat.
annotations.name: three-loop shift wrapper

annotations.limitations: Original-role previous-flag and zero-fill assumptions. Seeded reset dispatch reaches the wrapper with R7=FF and Q=D; physical dispatch and external-input behavior remain unresolved.
annotations.meaning: Left-shift Q until previous F=D+Q is zero; after return clear Q and write D+1 to R0.
annotations.name: input-matched left shift

annotations.limitations: Current-Y indexing is an alternative scenario; default index remains scenario-supplied. Physical D and address source unknown; no claim for every later visit.
annotations.meaning: At first tested reset entry current Y=(D+1) mod 256; optional current-Y indexing selects one of eight following branch words.
annotations.name: input-code dispatch candidate

annotations.limitations: External operands and output consumers unknown. Current flag timing selects last carry instead; defaults unchanged. Constant reset inputs in the tested dispatch path repeat.
annotations.meaning: Chain three byte additions into R1/R2/R3 while outputting old A values; previous-flag BLT repeats on middle carry.
annotations.name: carry-controlled three-add loop

annotations.limitations: Defined logical carry and previous-flag policy. Current timing tests a different predicate; reset-derived non-return cases constrain the hypothesis rather than prove hardware hangs.
annotations.meaning: Mask Q with R0 and test containment under previous flags; 126 adds R10 before and after its loop. Failed tests repeat without selecting external D.
annotations.name: idempotent Q-mask tests

annotations.limitations: Shared previous-flag and defined logical-carry policy is a local hypothesis. Physical D source and surrounding q2 caller behavior remain unverified; default unchanged.
annotations.meaning: Under q2 and previous-zero loop control, mask Q with R0 then wait until external D equals the masked value.
annotations.name: masked external-byte equality poll
